title: C: Macro Tricks
description: Create useful C preprocessor macros for min, max, assert, and array size.

steps.title: Utility Macros
steps.description: Define macros: `#define MIN(a,b) ((a)<(b)?(a):(b))`, `#define MAX(a,b) ((a)>(b)?(a):(b))`, `#define ARRAY_SIZE(arr) (sizeof(arr)/sizeof(arr[0]))`. Test them: find min/max of 10 and 20, and the length of `{1,2,3,4,5}`.
hints: Wrap macro parameters in parentheses to avoid precedence issues.
ARRAY_SIZE works on stack-allocated arrays only.

verification.failureMessage: Print min, max, and array size
